samples: Unsafe usage of optional chaining. If it short-circuits with 'undefined' the evaluation will throw TypeError.
what: An optional chain is used in a place that still throws when the chain short-circuits to undefined.

street.headline: Your `?.` fit still throw `TypeError`
street.happen: You use `?.` inside brackets, call, or spread. If the left side short-circuit to `undefined`, the next operation still throw.
street.todo: Check the value before you use am, or add another `?.`:
street.learn: `?.` only protect the step wey e dey on. E no protect the next operation.

normal.headline: This optional chain can still throw `TypeError`
normal.happen: The optional chain is used in a context that still throws when the chain short-circuits to `undefined`, such as a call, spread, or bracket access.
normal.todo: Check the value before you use am, or add another `?.`:
normal.learn: `?.` only protect the step wey e dey on. E no protect the next operation.
